replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: I don't like the concept which there is "Items" in the middle (The Sticks and Potions), stuff that's obtainable in CTW should be only in the wool rooms, and also I don't think it's good to have the center of the map connected, which means barely any bridging/skybridging. The game will seem to end too quick in that factor.
